title: Avenida Brazil: Carminha plots against Nina and secrets emerge
seoTitle: Carminha's scheme vs Nina on Avenida Brazil
subtitle: The rerun of the telenovela “Avenida Brazil” on “Vale a Pena Ver de Novo” heats up the rivalry between the protagonists with new traps and shocking revelations.
excerpt: The week of September 11‑18 in “Avenida Brazil” promises twists in Carminha’s revenge against Nina, with plans to ruin her reputation.
author: Daniele Morais
tags: Vale a Pena Ver de Novo
contentHtml:
The buzz around "September 14" is high due to the electrifying developments in the telenovela "Avenida Brazil", currently in rerun on Globo's "Vale a Pena Ver de Novo". João Emanuel Carneiro's plot intensifies with a turn in the rivalry between Nina and Carminha, promising high‑impact scenes in the upcoming episodes.

Carminha's revenge: the trap for Nina

The main move capturing viewers' attention is Carminha's (Adriana Esteves) attempt to turn the tables on Nina (Débora Falabella). The character seeks to retrieve compromising photos that the cook uses to blackmail her while simultaneously gathering evidence against her rival. Carminha plans to catch Nina in Max's (Marcello Novaes) arms, using that situation as a trump card in her strategy.

Carminha and Max's next steps

The schemer will strive to make Nina "taste her own poison." In a plan coordinated with Lúcio (Emiliano D'Avila) and Max himself, Carminha aims to destroy the cook's reputation. Max will lure Nina onto his boat under a pretext, where he will try to grab her and forcefully kiss her neck. Meanwhile, Lúcio will hide, photographing the scene so Carminha can use the images to push Nina out of her life, declaring: "I want to catch her in the act, just like she did to me! She’ll experience her own poison, my son. It will be an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth!"

Discoveries and confrontations at the mansion

The week also holds tense moments and revelations. Nina will try to convince Max that Carminha is deceiving him, while Jorginho (Cauã Reymond) will seek Betânia and Lucinda (Vera Holtz) to uncover Nina's past and her father's identity. Carminha, for her part, will confront Nina and will be caught by Tufão (Murilo Benício) handing over her belongings to Nilo. The latter, after being expelled from his flat, will swear revenge against Nina and will reveal to Carminha that the cook kept the money from his kidnapping, trying to persuade her to stay by his side. Janaína, the mansion's maid, will also show distrust toward Nina after overhearing a conversation between her and Max.

Other dramas in Divino

While the central clash sharpens, other characters will also see their fates move. Zezé will tell Tufão that he helped Carminha leave the mansion. Monalisa (Heloísa Périssé) will chat with Dolores and Beverly about moving to the South Zone, then with Ivana, mentioning that Tufão is in love with another woman. Olenka will break up with Silas. Nilo will pilot Max's speedboat, get stranded, and later follow Max to his boat, warning him to stay away from Carminha. Suelen will be photographed without clothes during a training session and will spend the night with Roni.

The soap that marked generations

"Avenida Brazil", written by João Emanuel Carneiro and directed by Amora Mautner and José Luiz Villamarim, originally aired on Globo in 2012. This is the second rerun of the work on "Vale a Pena Ver de Novo", and it continues to captivate audiences with its stories of revenge, love and secrets unfolding in the Divino neighborhood and the Tufão family mansion.

With information from Notícias da TV, Terra, Purepeople.
